biggest_catch: Samsung trade-in pays as credit toward a Samsung purchase, not cash - and your payout depends on your device's model and condition; you must own the item.
catches: Samsung trade-in pays as credit applied toward a Samsung purchase - not cash.
Payout depends on the exact device, model, and condition - you must own the device (leased devices are not eligible); the device must power on, have no cracks/liquid damage, and be factory reset.
If you do not send in the device within 15 days (or it fails eligibility), the applied credit is charged back to your card.
Eligible models and credit amounts may change at Samsung's sole discretion.

steps: Select a qualifying Samsung device on samsung.com and choose the trade-in option.
Answer the condition questions to get an estimated trade-in credit.
Send in your device within 15 days of receiving the new device.
Keep the credit applied at purchase once Samsung confirms the device meets eligibility.
